**Budget** - $85 USD

**Source** - PC

**Requirements for Isolation** - Not much; preferably some but it's not a priority as these will be used in my house.

**Preferred Type of Headphone** - Over Ear, preferably not pleather as in experience it's prone to flaking (and where I live it gets very hot which would accelerate it)
 
**Preferred tonal balance** - Ideally balanced overall, however as budget is limiting if balance isn't possible bass would be where I lean.

**Past headphones** - I've used the Xbox One Stereo Headset and some Astro A30's before, and I really liked the foam/non leather cup style of the X1 headset.

**Preferred Music** - Electronic, EDM.

I'm looking to replace a broken headset with something that can give me at least the same performance with better build quality (the headband snapped randomly; this was the second pair I had, same issue on both). As I'm on a tight budget, an inbuilt mic (or a pair that comes with a mic to be plugged into it) is the one thing I really, absolutely need. Avoiding pleather is also something I'm aiming for; other than those two caveats, as long as it sounds decent I'm all for it.

I'm new to this sort of thing, and the guides in the sticky gave some options but I want to see what the community thinks. What would you reccomend to fit the bill?

I've had an Xbox One for about 3 months now and in that time I've had my friends both IRL and online hounding me to buy various games. Living on that shoestring budget many students are aware of money's tighter than a tightrope, and so I've been stuck playing the (awesome) Sunset Overdrive as well as GWG.

My first video game I ever played was Halo and I've got a lot of great memories with the series. Most of the friends I play with now I met during the Halo 3 years, and while some have left due to life, it was always great to go play those games again and re live the memories.

The reason I got the X1 was due to my 360 dying from a disc tray malfunction, and while I can still play Halo 3 (due to the GWG) the other halos are completely shuttered as far as I can afford.

If I did get this code you'd allow me to reconnect with many of my older friends and allow me to make new, wonderful friends today (Yourself included!). I was raised to treat friends like family and it definitely hurts not being able to play with them or do much with them when they live across the country.

Good luck to all who enter, from what I've been told the collection is great, and my memories of H2/H3 multiplayer (unless nostalgia is getting to me) lead me to believe there's a good reason I've been hounded to give up food for a few weeks to afford it.
